thread:
Maya Chen: quick sync — we need to finalize launch gates for customers doing VPC/on-prem with customer-managed networking. primary asks from field:
- minimal downtime upgrades
- IP preservation
- ability to hand off routing to customer
Can we decide criteria + who owns ops handoff?

Samir Patel: +1. propose 3 launch tracks: 1) self-serve VPC (low touch), 2) assisted (field + SE), 3) on-prem airgapped with installer. each track gets specific acceptance tests & rollback windows. :thumbsup:

Leo Zhang: for upgrades — are we guaranteeing in-place upgrades for 1 -> 2 minor versions? customers expect rollback path. we should define max outage windows.

Olivia Ramos: acceptance criteria idea: installer smoke (dns, ip-preserve, metrics ingest), e2e traffic loopback test, operator-runbook validated. link: https://redwood-internal/docs/priv-deploy/gates

Maya Chen: agree. propose launch gate checklist:
- network handshake completed
- ip/prefix preservation tested
- installer dry-run on staging
- rollback tested
- support-runbook live
Who's owner? product owns checklist, eng-runtime owns upgrade tests, field/SE do customer validation.

Jordan (ops-bot): notice: outage SLOs required for track 2 and 3. default allowed maintenance window = 15m for minor patch; 2h for major. See /policy/maintenance

Samir Patel: concerning IP preservation — we need a non-invasive migration mode: keep existing service CIDRs, bring up new nodes with NAT masquerade, then cutover. sketch:
```
- keep existing VIP
- route traffic to proxy on new host
- drain old nodes
```

Leo Zhang: also need a compatibility matrix for kernel/iproute versions; field reported an edge-case with customer's F5 load balancer. putting that into backlog.

Olivia Ramos: test harness: add `network-handshake` test to nightly e2e. simple curl loop verifying service reply and traceroute sanity.

Maya Chen: next steps — draft gated checklist doc by Fri, owners tagged, prepare a short playbook for SE. Can someone own the doc?

Samir Patel: I'll draft the checklist, assign owners in doc, ping SEs for review. :eyes:

Leo Zhang: I'll add upgrade tests and the compatibility matrix to eng-runtime backlog.

Olivia Ramos: I'll own the SE playbook & field validation sheet.

Jordan (ops-bot): reminder: anyone scheduling a canary must file a launch form: forms.redwood/launch

Maya Chen: thanks. Quick question — do we need a customer signature on the handshake? some legal asked about explicit approval for ip changes.

Samir Patel: legal wants a short appr sign-off for on-prem major changes. we'll add a checkbox in the handoff doc.

Olivia Ramos: tagging @SE-team for heads up, will share draft.

Maya Chen: cool. closing this thread — will follow up with doc link.
